responsibility: This file implements a dynamically resized pointer-index array abstraction used by the mc-boot runtime to map integer indices to addresses. It owns the concrete index structure, allocation and growth logic, bounds tracking, optional debug bitmap checking, insertion, deletion, lookup, containment tests, and foreach traversal, and is notably used by neighboring runtime subsystems such as FIO to manage open-object tables.
same_name_distinction: Implements the resizable pointer-index table promised by GIndexing.h, including the concrete index record, storage growth, membership/removal logic, and foreach traversal code.
